zh: 我明天会再跟客户跟进一下。
en: I'll {follow up|check in|touch base} with the client tomorrow.

zh: 你能帮我查一下这个问题吗？
en: Can you {look into|look at|investigate|check} this issue for me?

zh: 她在研讨会上想出了一个很棒的主意。
en: She {came up with|thought of|thought up|had} a great idea in the workshop.

zh: 我们已经把发布推迟到下个月了。
en: We've {put off|pushed back|postponed|delayed} the launch until next month.

zh: 休假之前，我正在把手上的项目交接出去。
en: I'm {handing over|handing off|passing on} my projects before I go on leave.

zh: 假期回来后，我得把积压的邮件补上。
en: I need to {catch up on|go through|get through} my emails after the holiday.

zh: 本离开后，阿罗哈接手了这个项目。
en: Aroha {took over|picked up|took on} the project when Ben left.

zh: 他去年辞去了组长的职务。
en: He {stepped down|stood down|resigned|quit} as team lead last year.

zh: 明天的站会你能替我一下吗？
en: Can you {fill in for|cover for|stand in for} me at the stand-up tomorrow?

zh: 刚才的会上没有人提起预算的事。
en: Nobody {brought up|raised|mentioned} the budget in the meeting.

zh: 开会前我们把这些数字过一遍吧。
en: Let's {go over|go through|run through|look over|check|review} the numbers before the meeting.

zh: 我经理还没有批准这个预算。
en: My manager hasn't {signed off on|approved|signed off} the budget yet.

zh: 我们收个尾吧，时间到了。
en: Let's {wrap up|finish up|finish|stop} now. We're out of time.

zh: 你周五一般几点下班？
en: What time do you {knock off|finish|clock off|leave} on Fridays?

zh: 我已经约好周四和供应商开会了。
en: I've {set up|arranged|organised|organized|scheduled|booked} a meeting with the vendor for Thursday.

zh: 我今天下班前给你答复。
en: I'll {get back to|reply to|respond to} you by the end of the day.

zh: 他们在最后一刻取消了会议。
en: They {called off|cancelled|canceled} the meeting at the last minute.

zh: 她每天都要处理客户投诉。
en: She {deals with|handles} customer complaints every day.

zh: 抱歉打断了，请继续。
en: Sorry to interrupt. Please {carry on|go on|continue|keep going|go ahead}.

zh: 律师们这周正在起草合同。
en: The lawyers are {drawing up|writing up|drafting|preparing|writing} the contract this week.
